note: Environment actions executed outside the runner, added to the campaign total by tools/ledger.py. Estimates use measured per-test action counts (2026-10-31) and the test runs recorded in the session transcript.

entries.basis: 23 recorded pytest runs + 2 runs with filtered output + 4 runs on 2026-10-31. Measured per full run: 278,618 (test_task 54,605; test_evaluate 1,654; test_ppo 3,016; RL smoke 163,325; resume 47,331; diagnostics 8,687). Smoke-era runs ~2.15M; earlier runs <=0.6M; interactive checks <=0.35M. Conservative upper bound used.

Before M4 (Amendment 2, B6): one run of the resume smoke test (~47k, plus one extra 64-layout diagnostic evaluation) and one full suite with BC2RL_SMOKE=1 (measured 278,618 per full run, plus the same extra evaluation). Conservative round-up.

Runner job r2-smoke (batch of experiments/r2/tests.batch.json, 2026-11-01): the RL smoke tests point MAE_RUN_DIR at temporary job directories, so the process's step record was written there and deleted. Point estimate = the same three tests measured on 2026-10-31 (163,325 + 47,331 + 8,687; CPU, fixed seeds). Conservative round-up. Fixed in src/bc2rl/accounting.py (record directory fixed at import) with tests/test_accounting.py::test_record_dir_fixed_at_import_not_by_later_env_changes.

entries.detail: Local opt-in smoke tests/test_p5_smoke.py (probe, straight D5 branch 2,048, paused 768, resumed 1,280, with evaluations) run once outside the runner during development of the 2026-11-02 programme; subprocess step records went to temporary run directories. Conservative upper estimate; in-process local checks are measured separately (.mae/unmanaged_actions). Replaced 2026-11-02 by the measured value: the same deterministic tests (CPU, fixed seeds) run through the runner in p5-smoke (batch 20261102T101613-56399) recorded 30,127 + 27,292 + 768 + 26,524 = 84,711 subprocess actions.

entries.basis: Runner job a4-smoke (batch 20261102T004225-31353, A4 tests batch): tests/test_pause_smoke.py started real jobs as subprocesses with a temporary MAE_RUN_DIR, so their step records were deleted with it. Measured by the deterministic rerun in p5-smoke (batch 20261102T101613-56399, mirrored records): 29,941 + 22,528 + 11,557 + 10,971 = 74,997. An A4 cost, charged to the 2026-11-02 programme ledger (conservative). Fixed by BC2RL_STEPS_MIRROR (src/bc2rl/accounting.py).

2026-11-03 local smoke runs of bc2rl.capability (collect 928 + 872; validate 130 + 157 + 130 + 157) were started with MAE_RUN_DIR pointing at a session scratch directory, so bc2rl.accounting treated them as managed and wrote their step records there instead of .mae/unmanaged_actions. Summed from those six records (one per process). Charged to the 2026-11-03 capability audit (500k cap). Later local checks run without MAE_RUN_DIR.
